summary: anyComponentStyle's maximumError ratchets 20kB -> 17kB in angular.json, measured fresh: config-manager 16.81kB (worst), guest-manager 11.69kB, milestones 11.40kB, seating-plan 9.45kB. 17kB is 190 bytes above the worst screen. 8kB maximumWarning untouched, no per-path override. Gate proven to bite: a scratch rule pushed config-manager.scss to 17.05kB and pnpm build failed (exit 1, explicit ERROR line); reverted immediately. Production build passes clean before and after. Hub ARCHITECTURE.md's bullet left to a hub session per repo-boundary instruction -- exact wording proposed in this report.

acceptance.criterion: Rewritten 2026-09-04 (hub ADR-0041 §7, re-amended): this task no longer flips the warning to an error across all four screens (unsatisfiable, withdrawn) -- it tightens the maximumError instead. Read §7's amendment before starting.
acceptance.evidence: Read docs/decisions/0041-*.md §7's full amendment block (the 're-amended the same day' version) before making any change. Confirmed against angular.json (maximumWarning: 8kB / maximumError: 20kB at start) and T343's own status line (all four screens migrated, done 2026-09-04) that the dependency had landed.

acceptance.criterion: The 8kB maximumWarning stays exactly as it is -- not re-baselined, and no per-path overrides added (four per-path exceptions is the same repeal reached one screen at a time).
acceptance.evidence: git diff angular.json shows a single line changed: `"maximumError": "20kB"` -> `"maximumError": "17kB"`. `"maximumWarning": "8kB"` is byte-identical before and after. No `configurations`/per-path budget entries were added anywhere in angular.json -- grep -c '"type": "anyComponentStyle"' angular.json = 1, unchanged from before this task.

acceptance.criterion: maximumError ratchets from 20kB down to just above the worst measured screen, measured at the moment this task lands rather than reusing an earlier report's figure.
acceptance.evidence: pnpm build run fresh from a clean tree on 2026-09-05 (this session), output: config-manager.scss 16.81kB (8.81kB over the 8kB warning) -- the worst of the four -- guest-manager.scss 11.69kB, milestones.scss 11.40kB, seating-plan.scss 9.45kB. All four match T343's own closing figures exactly, confirming no drift landed on main between T343's last commit (2e2d364) and this measurement. Set maximumError to 17kB: 190 bytes (~1.1%) above 16.81kB -- tight enough that the next real growth on config-manager fails the build (proven below), loose enough that ~190 bytes of legitimate small-edit headroom exists before a routine change trips the gate on rounding alone. Chose a round kB value consistent with the existing 8kB/20kB style rather than an exact-byte figure like '16.82kB', since angular.json's own budgets are already round numbers and the CLI's own reporting is 2-decimal kB, not bytes.

risks.risk: 17kB leaves config-manager only 190 bytes (~1.1%) of headroom. T354 (closing config-manager's residual gap, parked outside this phase's exit condition per the phase's own 'What this task is NOT' framing) is the next task likely to touch this file's size in either direction -- if it trims the file, the ratchet should tighten again rather than sit stale at a now-loose 17kB; if a future unrelated small edit adds even a single token-substituted declaration, it may trip the gate immediately. Neither is a defect in this task's own work, but the next screen-size-affecting change to config-manager.scss should re-measure and consider re-ratcheting rather than assuming 17kB stays correct indefinitely.
